name: Categorical Color Maps
definition: A rendering technique for visualizing data arrays containing enumerations (e.g., element types, gear types) or categories, where numerical values are not continuous scalars but discrete identifiers. It solves the problem that traditional interpolated color transfer functions are tedious and cumbersome for discrete data.
summary: Categorical color maps render discrete data by mapping specific values to exact colors via a lookup table, avoiding the complexity of continuous transfer functions.
